issues.summary: Improve mobile responsiveness on checkout page

comments.author: Kavya Arora
comments.text: "The saved address dropdown overflows on small screens. Switching to a full-width select on mobile should fix it."

comments.author: Kavya Arora
comments.text: "Profiled it — most of the delay is from fetching saved addresses on every render, even for guests. Should skip that call for guest checkout."

comments.author: Kavya Arora
comments.text: "Should this use Resend like the order confirmation emails already do, or do we want a separate email service for security-sensitive emails?" "Let's reuse Resend to keep things simple — we can revisit if we ever need stricter deliverability guarantees."

comments.author: Kavya Arora
comments.text: "Turns out this only happens under high load — two webhook events for the same order arrive within milliseconds and both try to update the order status." "Going with a database-level lock on the order ID instead of an in-memory flag, since the app can restart between events."
